terms.comment: Classically a four-wheeled travelling carriage, a Gaulish word (Quint. 1.5.57; Caes. BG 1.51.2; Cic. Mil. 28, all from Lewis & Short). Traupman and Andresian use it for the car itself; autoraeda says which kind of carriage.

phrases.latin: Nec autoraedā, nam nimis longum est iter
phrases.english: Nor by car, for the journey is too long

sources: Lewis & Short: raeda
